verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a fraud-protection SaaS platform, but the evidence only documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, webhooks and a Try It! panel. None of it describes a conversational assistant, copilot, or natural-language command interface. API and spec materials are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
